text:
jess: saturday dilemma — sunrise ridge hike (meet 6:15am at lot), vendor fair with hot chocolate at the community hall (10am) or full chill day? vote and/or bribe me with snacks. 

marco: sunrise hike for pics, vendor fair for pastries, chill for sleeping — i'm torn. :camera_with_flash: :croissant:

anika: vendor fair! i've been meaning to support local makers and buy more enamel pins. also hot chocolate = yes.

diego: if it's sunrise i'm in but only if someone promises slow pace — i am not a mountain goat. :sweat_smile:

olga: chill day. need to finish a very small ikea project and emotionally recover from a week of meetings. also can bake banana bread if people want it later.

jess: options: 1) ridge sunrise hike 6:15 2) vendor fair + hot chocolate 10am 3) chill + banana bread. react with :one: :two: :three:

marco: :one: (but i will definitely buy pastries after)

anika: :two:

diego: :one: (slow pace pls)

olga: :three: (banana bread offer stands)

jess: looks like a split — hike has a few, vendor fair has anika, chill has olga. new idea: hike -> vendor fair (slow hike, pastries afterwards). who would do both? react :both:

marco: :both: (i spy a pastry trade)

anika: :both: if there's hot chocolate at the fair

diego: :both: as long as pace is turtle-tier

olga: maybe i'll join vendor fair only around 10:30 for baking procurement and then head home for banana bread prep

calendar-bot: Reminder: Community Hall vendor fair reserved saturday 09:45-13:00. Please follow setup notes in #events.

jess: plan: meet for a gentle sunrise ridge hike at 6:15, slow pace, then head to vendor fair around 9:45. olga will likely join at 10:30. i'll bring a small thermos of coffee and a camera.

anika: i'll bring cash for pins and an extra thermos if someone wants second hot chocolate.

diego: i'll bring a tiny first-aid kit and 2 granola bars

olga: banana bread will exist by 2pm for anyone who needs consolation. DM me if you want a slice.

jess: i'll post pins for meetup location and a quick RSVP count. thanks all — see you saturday!
